Export design

Choose editable parameters, a 3D model, or a snapshot.

IFC, GLB, floor CSV and DXF export the FORM parametric building only. Use FORM package to retain every imported model and its placement.

JSON preserves the editable form. GLB contains the generated model. IFC exports conceptual slabs and an envelope proxy; no internal layout or detailed wall systems. Slab thicknesses are nominal.

Your form, your rules.

Start with a footprint and floor count. Open Modifiers to add twist, taper, lean, bend, bulge, or setbacks. Each change rebuilds the floor plates and envelope.

Navigate: drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, and right-drag or use two fingers to pan. Use Front, Side, and Top for orthographic views.

Compare: save a design, change the form, then choose Compare on a saved card to place it alongside your current design.

Units: metres, square metres, and degrees. The tower storey count excludes the podium. Areas include the entire floor outline, with no deductions.

Changes are recovered on this browser where storage is available. Download JSON backups for long-term use. A compatible WebGL2 browser is required.

Three.js · MIT licence. FORM is a conceptual massing tool. Geometry has not been checked for structural feasibility or regulatory compliance.
